classification.release: v2026-01 (as labelled on the mirror pages checked)
classification.licence: CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Codes and titles are carried unmodified and attributed to WHO; local synonyms live on the MedSync term, never in the classification.
classification.verification: verified-mirror: code and exact title read on the findacode.com ICD-11 MMS page named in source, 2026-09-26. Where the code is a residual (.Y/.Z) or a child listed on its parent page, source is that parent page. Confirm at icd.who.int before any export.

rules: icd10_who stays null until a WHO ICD-10 licence is recorded (E6, owner action O-3).
idsr_class and hmis_category_id stay null until REF-IDSR-CLASSES and REF-HMIS-MAP are signed.
Symptom-level terms ("..., cause not yet known") are preferred over a premature disease label (MS-EMR-CLIN-001 [04]).
sensitivity follows D-CFC-09: HIV, TB, STI/SRH and mental illness are restricted.

conditionalSensitivity.rule: restricted when the patient is under 18 (D-CFC-09, pregnancy in minors); applied at write time from the patient age

codingNotes.dx.malaria_uncomplicated: 1F4Z does not name the species. If the CSO prefers the falciparum code for mRDT-confirmed malaria, 1F40.Z (Malaria due to Plasmodium falciparum, unspecified) is on the same page.
codingNotes.dx.malaria_severe: 1F40.Y assumes P. falciparum and excludes cerebral complications (use dx.malaria_cerebral, 1F40.0).
codingNotes.dx.hiv: Unstaged code. Staged codes 1C62.0-1C62.3 and TB- or malaria-associated codes (1C60, 1C61) exist; staging is a later refinement.
codingNotes.dx.sti_urethral_discharge: Syndromic term mapped to the residual STI code; organism-specific codes (gonococcal 1A70-, chlamydial 1A80-) apply once confirmed.
codingNotes.dx.sti_genital_ulcer: Syndromic term mapped to the residual STI code; syphilis, chancroid (1A90) and anogenital herpes (1A94) have their own codes once confirmed.
codingNotes.dx.vaginal_discharge: Mapped to the symptom code, because vaginal discharge is often not an STI; restricted because it sits in the STI syndromic pathway.
codingNotes.dx.dka: 5A22.0 is DKA without coma; DKA with coma is 5A22.3. The type of diabetes is post-coordinated (for example 5A22.0/5A11).
codingNotes.dx.epilepsy: Shares 8A6Z with dx.seizure_unexplained; specific epilepsy codes 8A60-8A62 exist.
codingNotes.dx.psychosis: 6A2Z assumes a primary psychotic disorder; substance-induced (for example 6C40.6) and secondary psychotic syndromes have their own codes.
codingNotes.dx.snakebite: The ICD-11 index places snake envenomation under NE61; add the substance extension code when post-coordination is supported.
codingNotes.dx.rabies_exposure: Codes the exposure. The wound itself is dx.open_wound (ND56.1).
codingNotes.dx.sickle_cell_crisis: chronic is true so the problem-list prompt offers sickle cell disease.
